ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a left-right symmetric isosceles triangle, with the base horizontal, and the vertex directly above the midpoint of the base. A semicircle is located inside the triangle, the diameter of the semicircle is placed along the base of the triangle, the arc faces upward, and the arc is tangent to the two equal slanted sides of the triangle. Reasoning: According to the coordinate geometry method, place the midpoint of the base of the isosceles triangle at the origin, and place the base on the x-axis. Because the base length is 16, the endpoints of the base are (-8,0) and (8,0). The height is 15, so the vertex is (0,15). The semicircle is symmetric about the y-axis, and the diameter is on the base, therefore the center of the circle corresponding to the semicircle is (0,0), and let the radius be r. Take the right slanted side, it passes through (8,0) and (0,15). Its slope is (15-0)/(0-8)=-15/8, so the equation of the line is y=-15x/8+15, converted to standard form: 15x+8y-120=0. The arc of the semicircle is tangent to this slanted side, therefore the perpendicular distance from the center (0,0) to this line is the radius r. Use the point-to-line distance formula: r = |15(0)+8(0)-120| / sqrt(15^2+8^2) = 120 / sqrt(225+64) = 120/17. So the radius of the semicircle is 120/17.

From the text, use base 16 and height 15, so place the base endpoints at (-8,0) and (8,0), the apex at (0,15), and the semicircle center at (0,0). Write the equation of one slanted side, for example through (8,0) and (0,15). Since the circle/semicircle is tangent to that side, the radius equals the perpendicular distance from (0,0) to this line. Compute that distance using the point-to-line distance formula to get r = 120/17.

推理：按坐标几何方法，把等腰三角形底边中点放在原点，底边放在 x 轴上。因为底边长为 16，所以底边端点为 (-8,0) 和 (8,0)。高度为 15，所以顶点为 (0,15)。半圆关于 y 轴对称，直径在底边上，因此半圆对应圆的圆心为 (0,0)，设半径为 r。

取右侧斜边，它经过 (8,0) 和 (0,15)。其斜率为 (15-0)/(0-8)=-15/8，所以直线方程为 y=-15x/8+15，化为标准式：15x+8y-120=0。

半圆的圆弧与该斜边相切，因此圆心 (0,0) 到这条直线的垂直距离就是半径 r。用点到直线距离公式：
r = |15(0)+8(0)-120| / sqrt(15^2+8^2) = 120 / sqrt(225+64) = 120/17。

所以半圆的半径是 120/17。

method.method_draft: Use a right-triangle altitude/area route. From the image, split the isosceles triangle down its altitude through the center of the semicircle; this gives a right triangle with horizontal leg 8, vertical leg 15, and hypotenuse one slanted side of length 17. The semicircle is tangent to that slanted side, so the radius drawn to the tangency point is perpendicular to the hypotenuse. Thus the desired radius is the altitude from the right-angle vertex on the base midpoint to the hypotenuse of the 8-15-17 right triangle. Compute the area in two ways: (1/2)(8)(15) = (1/2)(17)r, giving r = 120/17.

claims.claim: Substitute the center (0,0) and the straight line 15x+8y-120=0 into the point-to-line distance formula and simplify, obtaining the semicircle radius r=120/17.
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: r = |15(0)+8(0)-120| / sqrt(15^2+8^2) = 120 / sqrt(225+64) = 120/17; so the radius of the semicircle is 120/17
